adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt` is constructed with `destinationCalendar` set to `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (around lines 1060-1067 in the diff). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. If both the event type and organizer lack a destination calendar but other hosts have one (which is exactly when `teamDestinationCalendars` would be populated from `users.slice(1)`), `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, so `?.push(...)` is a silent no-op and those team destination calendars never get passed downstream. This is a correctness defect directly visible in the diff.
